No privacy when talking to receptionists as everybody is staring at you with all chairs looking in same direction. Uncomfortable chairs. Some receptionists are quite rude, while others are friendly. Doctors are friendly, when you can see them...

When you try to call, you're sometimes waiting a stupid amount of time. I rung them and started to walk to them at the same time. The walk is 45mins. I walked there quicker than they answered the phone. When I walked in (still on hold) the reception staff were doing nothing. Not busy at all. I told them I was calling them (and had been for 45mins) and they had nothing to say. Useless.

I've found out that a better way of doing it, is calling 111. And telling them something to make the doctors at the GP ring you back. Saves so much time. Cut out the GP receptionists all together.

When you do get through, they never have any appointments anyway. Just call 111 once the surgery is shut. If the call while the surgery is open, 111 will tell you to call the surgery. The NHS is a joke. Call 111 after the surgery is shut, and you'll be able to speak to a doctor within an hour.
